caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric rendered in shades of gray and black on an off-white background. The fabric features a detailed pattern: the upper portion has a faint, linear texture with small scattered flower-like motifs, while the lower portion is more densely decorated with larger, detailed floral and leafy designs. The bottom edge of the fabric has a scalloped border, and the scallops are outlined and filled with small floral embellishments. There is a signature or inscription in the lower right corner of the drawing. The overall composition is centered, with the fabric taking up most of the space on the paper.
title: Embroidered Undersleeve
